[SWS_CM_00700] Ensure memory allocation of maxSampleCount samples
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00103
⌈
The Communication Management shall ensure, that after returning from method
Sub-
scribe()
sufficient memory resources are available, so that the number of samples
given in parameter
maxSampleCount
can be concurrently accessed by application
layer.
⌋
